children: Saba Capital Management, L.P., a 10% owner, purchased 49,246 shares of Mexico Fund common stock on November 20, 2026, at $19.71 per share, for a total purchase amount of $970,639. The shares were held by funds and/or accounts for which Saba Capital Management, L.P. serves as investment manager. Following the transaction, Saba Capital Management, L.P. indirectly owned 2,686,467 shares. Boaz R. Weinstein is the managing member of Saba Capital Management GP, LLC, the general partner of Saba Capital Management, L.P.
